author: metacritic0auhc
quote:
After a thirteen-year wait, the world's most famous crime game opens with a . . .  to-do list?

Expecting a bank job, I found myself flipping burgers, playing mini-golf, fetching a dog, grocery shopping, assembling furniture, and painting walls. HOURS of errands, which was roughly the length of a heist in any previous GTA.

Then there is the morality system. Imagine buying a game whose title is a felony and getting graded on conduct. For thirty years GTA sold consequence-free chaos, whereas GTA 6 force-feeds us a conduct record, cars that stay broken, and a solipsistic partner with insane opinions that you have to treat with kid gloves lest the game punish you like an errant child.

After awhile, the 30 frames per second, with no 60fps mode, is terrible on the eyes. It dips even below that low bar in crowded streets. The whole time playing, I experienced constant crashes, and several times I lost progress despite autosave. Lucia fell through the ground during the prologue. In one mission, Jason walked straight through the side of a plane. At other points NPCs swam sideways, planes flew through buildings, and cars launched into orbit. 

I have to wonder: what alternate game are the 10/10 reviewers playing?
